summary: Both supplied occurrences instantiate the existing I.1 unterschreiben and Preterit mḏ̣alle with plural l-agents. No missing stem, box or sense is established.

The signed documents occur as a fronted object at Hors 1/32 and are resumed by aʕlayye at 57/149. The latter locates signing on the documents; it does not establish a separate verb-plus-preposition sense.
Hors 1/32 corresponds to the entry's EL 32 quotation. Its four-hour delay and withheld signature provide historical context but do not justify duplicating the same lexical example.
This is an Arabic-derived administrative verb, already identified in the entry etymology; there is no light verb plus action noun construction in either occurrence.
